verdicts.reason: A: the headline fills the canvas, but the 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow and the divider are shrunk to an unreadable orange speck. The body copy is set larger than the CTA column and sits next to it. 'Ships late June' and the legal block are microscopic, so the right column feels cramped. The 'Reserve a Case' button is at least legible and prominent. B has the same layout but shrinks the CTA button to an illegible chip that the body copy dwarfs, so the call to action is buried and the hierarchy is inverted. That makes B clearly worse.
